blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Here are INQToday’s top stories this afternoon: Vice President Sara Duterte retains the approval and trust of a slim majority of Filipinos, while nearly half of respondents disapprove of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s performance and distrust him, a new survey shows. Meanwhile, the Philippine peso hits a record low against the US dollar before retreating to the P63 level, as inflation and corruption remain among Filipinos’ top concerns in another survey. /dp READ: Pulse Asia survey Sara Duterte retains majority approval and trust...
